overall.visualConsequence: Downstream completion would hide unresolved primary forms.
overall.recommendedAction: Prioritize proportions, face and eyes; keep delivery blocked.

silhouette.observedProblem: The primary proportion pass reads as a young-adult silhouette; shoulder seam/outline artifacts remain for construction and lookdev review.
silhouette.visualConsequence: Head-to-body scale now supports the intended adult design instead of dominating it.
silhouette.recommendedAction: Keep silhouette proportions and repair face/eyes next; defer garment details.

face.observedProblem: Nose projects as a rounded bulb and cheek/jaw transition is generic.
face.visualConsequence: Portrait lacks deliberate anime facial planes.
face.recommendedAction: Reshape the continuous facial mesh, restrain nose projection and define jaw/chin planes.

eyes.observedProblem: Upper/lower sclera exposure surrounds nearly circular irises; orbital shelf is thick.
eyes.visualConsequence: The neutral expression looks startled and eyes sit on top of the face.
eyes.recommendedAction: Flatten lower lid, shape upper arch and tapered canthus, occlude iris and reduce eye depth.

profile.observedProblem: Nose projection and mouth/chin transitions need deliberate shaping.
profile.visualConsequence: Side view resembles a generic generated avatar.
profile.recommendedAction: Edit profile curvature and inspect a matched side render.

hair.observedProblem: Uniform swept locks and cap read as smooth extruded chunks.
hair.visualConsequence: Hair lacks directional hierarchy and highlight design.
hair.recommendedAction: Reshape large masses first; replace repeated crown locks with intentionally varied clumps.

anatomy.observedProblem: Tube-like shoulders and limbs lack deliberate landmarks.
anatomy.visualConsequence: Body proportions and gesture do not match the intended adult anime quality.
anatomy.recommendedAction: Adjust body landmarks and shape shoulders, ribcage, wrists and knees.

clothing.observedProblem: Jacket is narrow and smooth despite small seam details.
clothing.visualConsequence: Tertiary details distract from weak garment silhouette.
clothing.recommendedAction: Shape shoulder/yoke, hem and sleeve tension; defer added stitching.

hands.observedProblem: Separate digit bases and palm transition remain construction topology.
hands.visualConsequence: Hand lacks a convincing thenar region and knuckle grouping.
hands.recommendedAction: Unify palm/thumb/finger roots and sculpt the hand before rigging.

materials.observedProblem: New source palette and hair bands need visual tuning.
materials.recommendedAction: Fix forms first, then evaluate controlled material responses.

shader.observedProblem: Directional anime source shader is newly installed and needs face-side evaluation.
shader.visualConsequence: Node execution alone does not establish attractive shadows.
shader.recommendedAction: Inspect all key directions, tune SDF contour and material separation.

deformation.observedProblem: Legacy rig is archived and unapproved.
deformation.visualConsequence: Static source cannot establish deformation quality.
deformation.recommendedAction: Do not rig until source visual gates pass.
